Hey - in mathlib there is the proof that degenerate simplex are compositions of unique non-degenerate simplexes + degeneracy maps for Simplicial Sets here: https://github.com/leanprover-community/mathlib4/blob/ac10dc7e9a3d44afd90aaeab0b5246310ac3c787/Mathlib/AlgebraicTopology/SimplicialSet/Degenerate.lean#L233-L257

This can be generalized to Eilenberg Zilber categories as defined in https://cisinski.app.uni-regensburg.de/CatLR.pdf 1.3.1 here, which will make this property apply to other categories such as dendroidal sets.

Wondering if this would be welcome as a contribution, should be relatively small, self-contained and just generalizing an existing mathlib result.

Eilenberg-Zilber categories are closely related to Reedy categories (see docs#HomotopicalAlgebra.ReedyStructure and https://github.com/joelriou/reedy). It seems it could be phrased by adding one or two extra axioms to ReedyStructure. In June, there were some discussions with @Christian Merten, @Robin Carlier and maybe @Sophie Morel on these topics, I do not know if they have already some code about Eilenberg-Zilber categories.
I don’t have any code on them right now. I’d be happy to review code on them.
I don't have code on them either.
